style.name: Olive Atelier
style.definition: An artful olive and parchment room with comfortable shapes and an unfussy collected feel.
style.materials: olive linen; parchment wool; walnut; travertine; bronze
style.living: olive tailored curved-arm 205cm sofa; parchment wool chair; oval travertine coffee table; walnut media cabinet; 105cm walnut table and four parchment chairs; bronze linen pendant
style.bed: olive low upholstered queen; walnut nightstands; parchment ceramic lamps; cream bedding
style.solarium: teak and olive outdoor cushions; compact teak dining set
style.implement: Layer two differently sized artworks beside a small vintage mirror; use olive linen rather than high-shine velvet.
style.avoid: Avoid rustic distressing and too many small objects.
